notes: Tirumala 3 — P11 Rectangular Home ICU & Shortened Veranda Return. 40 ft N-S x 50 ft E-W northeast-corner plot in Tirumala Colony with East principal arrival, adjustable 6-inch lower car porch (provisional), 24x48 in warm white/cream marble-look vitrified flooring across house, veranda, raised east forecourt and passages, traditional Kota/paver car-porch finish, and modern charcoal-bronze glazing. G+1 revision: upper master above the ground master, office, guest bedroom, open terrace and gallery above double-height living. Ground dimensions retained. ICU entrance has hall-side wooden privacy doors with sliding glass directly behind them. User-approved Ivory/limestone/teak palette; tall picture glazing with sliding side vents. P13 revision: ICU extends 2 ft east to the kitchen front wall, retaining a 5 ft forecourt. ICU clear size 11 ft 3 in × 13 ft 4 7/8 in (150.8 sq ft). Two extra ICU chairs and the tall cabinet are removed; one companion chair, the same recliner, TV and compact closed drawer table remain. Bed is recentered 1 ft east with its head west and feet east. All ground rooms other than ICU, door openings, kitchen, veranda, parking and stair footprints remain unchanged. The terrace roof plate follows the enlarged ICU; upper enclosed rooms and gallery remain unchanged.
